summary: axod initializes private local runtime state, opens session and relay services, then serves the local RPC endpoint until shutdown.
trigger: The per-user LaunchAgent or user starts axod without the terminal-attach subcommand.

steps.action: The bundled per-user LaunchAgent starts at login, remains alive, runs at Interactive priority with five-second launchd throttle, and supplies relay URL/PATH; axod resolves the state directory, configures rotated private logs and raises descriptor limit when possible.
Prepare the private server and runtime directories; reject invalid or overlong socket paths and refuse to replace a live socket or non-socket file.
Restore session state and start optional host relay support using local credentials.
Bind the Unix socket with mode 0600, write a process-owned PID file, and serve JSON-RPC until SIGTERM or SIGINT.
Stop relay and sessions, remove its PID file only if it still names this process, and finish shutdown.
